response.sql:
SELECT s.zoneref AS site_code,
       st.phasefactor AS historical_phase,
       AVG(s.scancount) AS average_scancount,
       AVG(s.pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio
FROM scans AS s
JOIN sites AS st
  ON s.zoneref = st.zoneregistry
WHERE s.scancount > 11
GROUP BY s.zoneref, st.phasefactor
ORDER BY average_compression_ratio DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: “Clears the 11-scan mark” means scancount is strictly greater than 11. SQL AVG ignores NULL values; combinations with all pressratio values missing sort last.
